summary.goal: Migrate planner-ui to use the same design system and component patterns as relay-dashboard, enabling direct code reuse and visual consistency across the agentworkforce package ecosystem.
in_scope: Audit relay-dashboard design system (colors, typography, components, patterns)
Audit planner-ui current components and styles
Gap analysis between the two systems
Component library selection (adopt whatever relay-dashboard uses)
Incremental migration of all UI components
Cleanup of deprecated styles and components
constraints: Prefer direct code reuse where feasible
Incremental migration to avoid big-bang risk
Human approval gates at key decision points

acceptance_criteria.description: planner-ui uses the same component library as relay-dashboard
Color palette matches relay-dashboard design tokens
All Button components use shared/consistent implementation
All Form components (inputs, selects, checkboxes) use shared/consistent implementation
All Modal/Dialog components use shared/consistent implementation
All Card and layout components use shared/consistent implementation
No deprecated custom CSS remains for migrated components
Visual regression tests pass for all pages
